title: Touchless faucet not detecting hand
shortDescription: IR sensor view obstructed or contaminated.
fullDescription: Kraus Oletto and Sellette touchless faucets use a forward IR sensor. When the lens is splashed with food residue or hard-water film, detection range collapses and the faucet stops responding.

fixSteps.title: Wipe sensor
fixSteps.instruction: Clean the small lens at the base of the spout with a microfiber and white vinegar.

whenToCallPro: If still no response after cleaning.

title: Battery pack near depletion
shortDescription: 6x AA pack voltage low; LED at base flashes red.
fullDescription: Kraus touchless faucets run on 6 AA cells in the under-sink box. Faucet response slows and a red LED blinks when voltage drops. Replace all six cells - do not mix old and new.

fixSteps.title: Replace AAs
fixSteps.instruction: Open the under-sink control box and install 6 fresh alkaline AAs.

title: Water continues after wave
fullDescription: If the solenoid coil overheats or the diaphragm shears, water continues to flow even after the sensor times out. Shut the under-sink valves and replace the solenoid.

fixSteps.title: Shut supply
fixSteps.instruction: Close hot and cold under-sink valves.

fixSteps.title: Replace solenoid
fixSteps.instruction: If still stuck on, swap the under-sink solenoid module.

title: Weak flow at spout
fullDescription: After install, debris from the line settles in the dual-spray aerator. Unscrew, soak in vinegar, rinse and reinstall.

fixSteps.title: Vinegar soak
fixSteps.instruction: Unscrew aerator, soak 30 min in white vinegar, rinse, reinstall.

title: Drip from spout swivel
shortDescription: O-ring set under spout collar dried out.
fullDescription: The pull-down spout swivels on two O-rings that need silicone grease. After 2-3 years they dry and seep. Replace the O-ring set with the manufacturer kit.

fixSteps.title: Replace O-rings
fixSteps.instruction: Shut supply, lift spout, swap O-rings, lubricate with silicone, reassemble.

title: Faucet runs at one temperature only
fullDescription: The single-handle ceramic cartridge can seize in extremely hard water. Faucet handle moves freely but temperature does not change. Replace the cartridge.

fixSteps.title: Replace cartridge
fixSteps.instruction: Shut supply, unscrew handle cap, remove retaining clip, swap cartridge.

title: Loud bang when faucet closes
shortDescription: Solenoid snaps shut producing pressure spike.
fullDescription: Touchless faucets close electrically, faster than manual taps. The pressure spike echoes back as water hammer. Install mini hammer arrestors at the supply hoses.

fixSteps.title: Add arrestors
fixSteps.instruction: Install Sioux Chief mini-rester between angle stop and faucet supply.

faq.a: Test - over 80 psi needs a PRV.

title: Alexa-enabled faucet drops voice pairing
fullDescription: Some Kraus models pair with Alexa via the Kraus app. Re-authentication is needed if your password changes or after a long offline period.

fixSteps.title: Re-link
fixSteps.instruction: In Alexa app, disable then re-enable the Kraus skill.

title: Drip from braided hose
shortDescription: Hose gasket worn or hose punctured.
fullDescription: The pull-down hose can wear at the spout end, especially if it rubs the back of the faucet body during retraction. Inspect and replace if seeping.

fixSteps.title: Replace hose
fixSteps.instruction: Disconnect, swap with Kraus replacement hose, route weight properly.

faq.a: Below sink rim - lets spout retract.

title: Faucet activates without input
shortDescription: Sensor false-triggering on bright sunlight or steam.
fullDescription: IR sensors can be confused by direct sunlight reflecting into the lens or by steam from a kettle nearby. Reposition faucet or shade window. Updating sensor firmware via the Kraus app helps on newer models.

fixSteps.title: Update firmware
fixSteps.instruction: On voice models, run firmware update via app.
